ff-fitness-chart.note: Training charts use direct lightweight SVG, accessible chart roles, explicit minimum-session/missing-data states and break lines across absent days instead of drawing false zeroes.

academicReview.note: Visualization behavior only.

ff-fitness-import.note: Workout import deterministically rejects malformed timestamps/negative optional metrics, does not invent sensor timestamps and merges normalized sessions by stable workout ID.

academicReview.note: Import/schema integrity only.

ff-fitness-fallback.note: Training preserves local history when device/server pulls fail, exposes empty-session state and pauses derived status on missing required profile inputs.

academicReview.note: Software fallback behavior only.

ff-fitness-offline.note: Workout history is localStorage-backed and remains usable when the backend is disabled or an automatic device pull fails; existing local sessions are not erased.

academicReview.note: Offline/local persistence only.

ff-fitness-data-quality.note: Workout runtime storage and import sanitize malformed identity/timestamps/sensor points/optional metrics, preserve timing evidence for HRR1 and prevent invalid values contaminating summaries.

academicReview.note: Data integrity/missingness handling only.

ff-fitness-performance.note: Training workbenches remain tab-lazy, local history is capped at 200 sessions/100 notifications, repeated localStorage parsing is cached and chart windows stay bounded.

academicReview.note: Frontend/storage performance constraints only.

ff-fitness-qa.note: Added Feature Factory regression coverage that composes existing deterministic workout import, summary and analytics contracts without promoting clinical or training-recommendation claims.

academicReview.note: Deterministic software QA only.
